independent_goals.evidence: Oatmeal cardigan body and both sleeves show repeated raised crossing cable braids, lower stitch channels and visible wool/loop relief.
The cardigan front plackets and wrist edges retain narrow parallel knitted columns distinct from the broader crossing cable field; the white cotton cuffs emerge through those wrist ends.
Cream and rust geometric stars and bands repeat on the pine-green vest chest and lower area; colored knit stitches share its green ground and remain distinct from the oatmeal cardigan.

White collar points rise within the green vest V-neck, white cuffs emerge inside both cardigan sleeve ends, and the white shirt lower panels/hem extend below the vest onto dark trousers. The visible boundaries retain shirt inside vest inside cardigan ownership.

Charcoal parallel rib columns are clear along both neck sides and one long free end reaches the lower left of the image. The other lower end is hidden by the bent cardigan sleeve/forearm; the full two-end outer-side arrangement cannot be assessed. This is an occlusion/partial-realization failure, not a claim that the scarf is absent.

The two hands and bench support are coherent and the paper label hangs from the right-held string. The planned tying/attachment action is only partial: both strands visibly descend in front of the branch, and an already-looped-around-branch path is not established. A nearby label and correct hand contact do not prove the label has been threaded around this branch.

selected_new_winter_relations.evidence: Both cardigan front edges remain separated. Wooden buttons at approximately x 648/y 886 and x 651/y 1033 remain sewn on the viewer-right front placket while the opposite edge stays across the visible vest/shirt gap. No button passes through the opposing edge/buttonhole or joins the two edges. A button-bearing cardigan alone does not realize the adopted closure relation.

main_impression_before_controls: A warm, tactile and quietly intimate winter work portrait. The face and layered wool form the main visual mass; the hands, hanging label and snow-coated branch give it a useful present-tense task. The open snowy orchard and warm shed interior make the indoor-outdoor threshold credible.
whole_image_strengths: Cable relief, colorwork and crisp cotton edges have a clear tactile hierarchy.
The person appears concentrated on a connected horticultural action rather than simply displaying garments.
Snowy branch, hanging tag and other labeled twigs connect the task and place in one frame.
whole_image_weaknesses: The selected cardigan fastening relation is absent even though buttons are clearly rendered.
One scarf lower end is hidden and the tiny string contact loses readability in the thumbnail.

The label string is held in front of the branch, while the specified already-threaded encircling attachment remains unproven. The richer labeling mechanism described in the prompt is not fully supported by pixels.

controls_comparison.binding: Saved sensual=1, fetish=0, surreal=0, creativity=1 and sensual_led emphasis were preserved through core, pack, composed prompt and exact native payload.
controls_comparison.perceived_expression: Soft facial presence, parted lips and warm cheek light provide subtle supporting attraction within an ordinary task. The image reads realistic and restrained; aesthetic attention to wool is not proof of a fetish reading. The scene remains close to the independently selected winter work situation. Perceived prominence is a qualitative observation rather than a calibrated control score.

reference_appearance_observation: The visible short dark bob, fine bangs, softly rounded face and natural lips broadly follow the supplied face/hair guide. The different gaze, light and scene do not establish exact same-person identity. No identity-control hard profile was active.
proof_boundary: Original frozen goals, selected candidate relation, formal hard gates, whole-image impression and direct user judgment are separate. Independent knit successes do not substitute for the newly selected closure relation.

native_close_inspection_refinement.reason: The same native image was inspected closer at the critical knit/contact area. No criterion, prompt, target, image or image-call budget was changed; an unproven required loop was no longer credited from proximity alone.
